name: Shobach
overview: Shobach, also known as Shophach or Shopach, was the captain of the army under Hadarezer, the Syrian king, as described in 2 Samuel 10 and 1 Chronicles 19. He led the forces beyond the Euphrates River against Israel but was ultimately slain by King David's army during a decisive battle. These passages highlight God's providential victory for Israel through David, demonstrating the Lord's power over opposing armies and confirming David's role as God's chosen leader.
